messages:
nina: Quick sync 1: draft announce + benchmark deck done. Need eng/docs/sales signoff on changelog links, canary window, and UTMs before we set embargo. Can we confirm here? :mag:
omar: Paste the exact changelog line(s) you plan to publish and the tentative canary schedule. I can validate and add the fallback variant id if needed.
nina: Changelog snippet we're thinking to publish at top: `Improved inference routing with new canary policy and automatic lightweight-fallback to preserve latency under high load.` Full details in docs link (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/apr-announce-draft
leah: Webinar planned for Mon 04/06 17:00 PT. We need the registration UTMs + final SFDC mapping to wire the form. Also want to confirm whether the public post should highlight Dedicated customers separately.
reza: Short answer: call out Dedicated customers briefly. Behavior: Hosted will route via `route:default` and fallthrough to `quant-lite` when capacity throttles; Dedicated will remain pinned unless explicit fallback configured by tenant. Suggested public line: "Hosted customers benefit from an automated latency-preserving fallback when capacity is constrained; Dedicated customers see pinned capacity behavior unless they opt into fallback." Keep it short.
omar: Canary schedule proposal (eng): start Mon 04/06 00:00 UTC at 10% to variant `canary-lite-v3`, hold 6h, ramp to 40% Tue 04/07 06:00 UTC, 100% by Wed 04/08 02:00 UTC if metrics green. Rollback target: `stable-v2` and automatic fallback to `quant-ff` on token-error rate > 2%.
leah: UTMs proposed: utm_campaign=apr_release_2026&utm_medium=webinar&utm_source=email. For paid ads add utm_term=paid. For SFDC map -> queue: inbound > product > ml, with tag product:AprRelease26 and lead_priority:high for paid.
sales-ops: Confirmed SFDC mapping: queue=inbound_ml; add tags product=AprRelease26; lead_priority=high when utm_term=paid. Will create the form webhook once you confirm final UTMs.
ops-bot: Canary job created: name=apr-2026-canary, variant=canary-lite-v3, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/releases/apr-2026
nina: Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD today to set embargo lift for Thu 04/09 09:00 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: when your lane is green or reply with blockers.
omar: :thumbsup: Can confirm changelog wording and policy name. Will attach policy id to product notes.
leah: :thumbsup: I'll update the registration form UTMs and publish webinar page when we have final values.
reza: :thumbsup: Product OK. I added the Dedicated note to the draft copy.
sales-ops: :thumbsup: SFDC queued, will confirm webhook once final UTMs posted here.
ops-bot: Monitor alert if error_rate > 1.5% during canary will auto-pause traffic and notify #eng-oncall.
nina: Thanks all 60 I'll paste final staging changelog and the docs URL once Leah publishes. :rocket:
